name: Linear Precision SaaS
layout_principles: Persistent slim sidebar rail (240px) + fluid command-first main canvas
Hairline 1px borders and subtle tonal elevation instead of heavy drop shadows
Cmd+K command bar as first-class navigation and quick-action trigger
Tabular numeric columns with sticky headers and inline keyboard shortcuts
surface_treatment: Low-glare charcoal or clean neutral-slate surfaces with crisp 1px hairline borders and restrained single-hue focus accent.
avoid: Heavy glass blur over scrolling text

name: Editorial High-Craft Launch
layout_principles: Asymmetric 12-column editorial grid with bold display scale contrast (clamp 2.5rem..5.5rem)
Single unmistakable focal point above the fold; immediate SSR paint (no opacity:0 hero block)
Alternating wide media/interactive demo frames with tight 60ch narrative blocks
Proof-driven sections (live interactive widget, benchmark table, architectural diagram) over generic feature-icon trios
surface_treatment: Warm stone/bone paper or deep espresso-ink background paired with sculptural hairline rules and editorial serif/grotesque contrast.

name: Fintech & Institutional Ledger
layout_principles: Strict tabular-nums alignment across currency, delta percentages, and timestamps
Summary KPI strip anchored above sortable ledger table and reconciliation drawer
Dual semantic confirmation (icon + sign + text + color) for credit/debit/risk states
Zero ambiguous truncation on monetary values or account identifiers
surface_treatment: High-contrast porcelain or deep navy-slate with crisp emerald/crimson semantic delta chips and zero ornamental glow.

name: Swiss Grid Technical Docs
layout_principles: 3-column desktop architecture: left topic tree, 65ch center prose + code tabs, right sticky TOC
Instant keyboard search (/) and deep anchor links on every section heading
Copy-ready code blocks with language badge and line-highlight support
Zero decorative entrance animations blocking fast scanning
surface_treatment: High-legibility paper white or low-contrast dark ink with AAA-leaning body contrast and distinct inline code wells.
avoid: Auto-collapsing sidebar sections on every navigation

name: Atelier Tactile Commerce
layout_principles: Aspect-ratio locked product imagery (3:4 or 4:5) preventing CLS during scroll
Sticky purchase/variant bar on PDP paired with clear stock, shipping, and trust micro-copy
Slide-over cart drawer with optimistic quantity steppers and clear subtotal math
Fast faceted filtering via URL search params (shareable & back-button safe)
surface_treatment: Neutral alabaster/linen backdrop letting product photography dominate without competing chrome.
avoid: Full-page blocking newsletter popups on load

name: Clinical & Healthcare Clarity
layout_principles: WCAG AAA-first typography (>= 16px body, generous 1.6 line-height, 7:1 contrast target)
Unambiguous patient/record context bar pinned atop forms and multi-step workflows
Explicit icon + label alerts for warnings and critical thresholds (never color alone)
Large 44px+ hit targets across all interactive controls
surface_treatment: Calm off-white or muted sage/slate surfaces with high-clarity cerulean/teal actions and clear field borders.

name: Observability & DevTools Console
layout_principles: High-density split panes: filter query bar, timeline histogram, log/trace stream, inspector drawer
Monospace alignment for IDs, timestamps, latency p95/p99, and JSON payloads
Colorblind-safe chart palettes distinguishing series by stroke/marker as well as hue
Keyboard shortcuts for log stepping, query focus, and filter toggling
surface_treatment: Deep carbon/obsidian canvas with crisp hairline gridlines, high-contrast amber/emerald/cyan telemetry accents.
avoid: Oversized hero banners inside authenticated consoles

name: Spatial 3D & Interactive Studio
layout_principles: Full-bleed bounded viewport canvas (min-h-dvh) with floating translucent HUD toolbars (strictly single-layer blur)
Lazy-loaded Three.js/Canvas chunk paired with instant SVG/poster SSR placeholder
Explicit keyboard/button camera controls alongside pointer orbit + WebGL context-loss fallback
Static resting composition when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active
surface_treatment: Deep neutral studio matte backdrop framing interactive 3D/canvas artifacts without distracting chrome.
avoid: Text overlapping live canvas controls with < 4.5:1 contrast

name: Warm Humanist Workspace
layout_principles: Approachable generous radius (10px–14px) and warm stone neutrals instead of sterile cold greys
Clear conversational empty states and inline contextual helpers
Clean master-detail split on tablet/desktop collapsing to stack navigation on mobile
Friendly yet crisp typography with unmistakable primary CTA contrast
surface_treatment: Warm sand/oatmeal paper surfaces with earthy terracotta or forest accents and soft layered shadows.
avoid: Excessive emoji spam in every heading

name: Design System & Component Kit
layout_principles: Live interactive playground paired with prop table, keyboard map, and anatomy diagram
Token-driven variant matrix (size, variant, state) exposed via compound APIs
Side-by-side light/dark preview and explicit WCAG/APCA contrast badges
surface_treatment: Neutral calibrated canvas avoiding brand bias so component states and focus rings stand out cleanly.
avoid: Hardcoded component colors bypassing CSS variables
Boolean-prop sprawl instead of compound slots
